::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 29th [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.[^1]
:::

My dear [Mr Moor](people/person_1046.qmd)
Your letter followed me home from [Brighstone](organizations/other_140.qmd) whence I returned on Wednesday. I will give you 10/ for St Pauls church when next I have an opportunity, but on Monday I am going to Oxford and I do not come back till the 12th

Yours sincerely
C M  Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
